summary: On paper San Francisco has the edge (San Francisco ranks 1st of 32 in EPA per dropback, +0.39), one of its biggest strengths this season), while Buffalo's best counter is to win after the catch (Buffalo ranks 2nd in YAC over expected per catch, +0.5 yds). Under center, Brock Purdy ranks 1st of 31 in EPA per dropback and Josh Allen ranks 8th; x-factor: Khalil Shakir averages 3.7 yards of separation, 8th of 87, and San Francisco's pass defense ranks 3rd. The model favors San Francisco at 65%, mostly on starting QB (2.1 pts) and passing matchup (2.0 pts).
